## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## Ways to combat fake websites

The Commission has from time  to  time  received  reports  from  licensed  corporations  about fake  websites  that  try  to  imitate  their  websites  or  make  unauthorized  references  to  them (including the provision of links to their websites) in order to defraud investors.

To  help  protect  investors  and  licensed  corporations  from  unnecessary  loss  and  ensure integrity  of  the  market,  licensed  corporations  are  suggested  to  adopt,  as  a  minimum,  the following procedures when they discover any of such websites:

- (a) to report the incident to the Commission as soon as possible;
- (b) to report the incident to the Police as soon as possible; and
- (c) to alert the investing public of such website by effective means, which include, but are not limited to, issuing a press release,  an announcement in the newspapers and/or a warning on the licensed corporation's  website to clarify the incident.

Should you have any queries regarding the above, please contact Ms Madonna Yip at 28427618.
